text: Doors Open 2018, produced by Economic Development and Culture, will take place on Saturday, May 26, 2018 and Sunday, May 27, 2018. In order to include a photo exhibition by the City of Toronto's Photo Laureate Geoffrey James as part of the program, staff require a one-time exemption to the facility uses policies for City Hall. The photographs will be produced in vinyl and affixed to the windows on the front of City Hall (western side of main doors) at ground level, facing the square. They will be professionally installed and removed leaving no residue. The exhibition would be installed on Friday, May 25, 2018 and removed on Monday, June 4, 2018. Facilities has given permission to extend the exhibition for 10 days. The photographs recognize the 100th anniversary of the opening of the Prince Edward Viaduct. The exhibition combines contemporary images of the bridge by the Photo Laureate…

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve a one-time exemption to the policies governing facility usage at City Hall to allow the participation of the Photo Laureate in Doors Open 2018, such exemption to apply from Friday, May 25, 2018 to Monday, June 4, 2018.
